name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2456: The board never defined _gSetRoster while the console asked for it on every read, so the fleet set denominator was null forever and printed a bare number with a bar drawn full. It is defined now, both denominators carry their unit, an unknown draws EMPTY, and the cross-reference refusal names YOUR side or THEIR side instead of blaming the other console for a silence on your own.
